en-US.name: Safe-8-Sound
en-US.summary: Asks a simulated demo home how long its battery reserve keeps the safe room comfortable.
en-US.description: Development skill of the Safe-8-Sound hackathon project. It reads a simulated demo home through the project's MCP server: the battery level, the reserve in hours and the safe room. Read-only: it never changes anything in the home.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask safe eight sound how long the reserve lasts
Alexa, ask safe eight sound how the safe room is doing

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development only. The endpoint is the AlexaSkillFunctionArn output of the cold-reserve alexa-skill stack, set in the developer console.
